title: GitHub & delivery
summary: Connect review and release practices to the work happening in the workspace.

sections.heading: Prepare review
body: Keep proposed changes focused and provide enough context for reviewers to evaluate them.

sections.heading: Deliver deliberately
body: Use validation results and review signals to decide when a change is ready to ship.

examples.code:
git status
git add docs
git commit -m "Document workspace flow"

sections.heading: Keep traceability
body: Link implementation, review, and release information so the delivery decision can be understood later.
